system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Submits a livestock loan application. For your information, my loan_amount is dummy_loan_amount_7779, my project_type is dummy_project_type_3649, my project_description is dummy_project_description_6154, my aadhaar_number is 100020002484, my location is dummy_location_3256.

function.name: nabard_submit_application
function.description: Submits a livestock loan application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Farmer must be eligible. Does NOT approve or disburse loan. Fails if farmer is ineligible, duplicate application exists, or required documents are missing.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
